method: Inspected all three contact sheets and all 15 individual display-960 PNGs; inspected native PNG detail for architecture as well. Scores are ordinal agent judgments, not automatic metrics or a human study. Ignore blank page canvas outside the actual SVG image when judging compactness. No summed score or universal winner.
supplementalTitleCheck: Added as an explicit task-compliance check during image review, not one of the five preregistered visual dimensions. Source root labels alone do not prove a visible title.
